notes: The catalogue has arduino-leonardo, so it is used even though the parts list said None.
The schematic shows the input on pin 2, but the text and the breadboard image use pin 4. I followed the image and text (pin 4).
Breadboard naming follows the catalogue: bank 't' is rows a-e and bank 'b' is rows f-j. The image draws a-e in the lower half, so the mapping of image halves to bank letters is assumed.
The button sits across the centre gap in columns 6 and 8. Column 6 (side 1) goes to pin 4 and the pull-down resistor. Column 8 (side 2) goes to 5V.

The pull-down resistor goes from column 6 to the bottom negative rail (bn), which is wired to GND. The red 5V wire goes to the bottom positive rail (bp). Exact rail hole numbers are approximate; each rail is one strip.
The resistor is 10k, taken from the manual text. Its colour bands in the image were not checked.
